items.text: Fagnano (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against Dallas but will be available as the team's emergency quarterback if needed.

items.name: Brock Bowers
items.text: Bowers (knee) is active for Sunday's Week 3 matchup against the Saints.

items.name: Carson Beck
items.text: Beck (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the emergency third quarterback against the 49ers on Sunday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

items.name: Blake Treinen
items.text: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts told reporters Saturday that Treinen will be sidelined until next season due to a right shoulder injury, Fabian Ardaya of The Athletic reports.

items.name: Gabriel Moreno
items.text: Moreno (hamstring) has been removed from Sunday's lineup against the Padres, Alex Weiner of ArizonaSports.com reports.

items.name: Tony Gonsolin
items.text: The Royals placed Gonsolin on the 15-day injured list Sunday due to an allergic reaction.

items.name: Eli White
items.text: The Red Sox transferred White (foot) to the 60-day injured list Sunday.

items.name: Oneil Cruz
items.text: Cruz (knee) is absent from the lineup for Sunday's game versus the Tigers.

items.name: Ryan Miller
items.text: Miller (hip/back) is active for Sunday's game against the Chiefs.

items.name: Dalton Schultz
items.text: Schultz is in line to see an increase in targets for the second consecutive game in Sunday's Week 3 matchup against the Colts due to Nico Collins (hamstring) being ruled inactive for the contest.

items.name: Xavier Hutchinson
items.text: Hutchinson is in line to serve as the Texans' No. 1 receiver for the second consecutive game in Sunday's Week 3 matchup against the Colts due to Nico Collins (hamstring) being ruled inactive for the contest.

items.name: Justin Brazeau
items.text: Brazeau (lower body) was placed on injured reserve by the Penguins on Sunday.

items.name: Jonathan Pintaro
items.text: The Mets placed Pintaro on the 15-day injured list Sunday with an illness.

items.name: Kade Anderson
items.text: Anderson left Saturday's game against the Angels due to a left forearm bruise.

items.name: Jonnu Smith
items.text: Smith caught two passes on three targets for 16 yards during Thursday's 35-14 loss to Atlanta.

items.name: Griffin Jax
items.text: Jax was removed from Saturday's start against the Phillies due to a lower-back contusion, Marc Topkin of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

items.name: J. Michael Sturdivant
items.text: Sturdivant tallied three catches on as many targets for 22 yards during the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons on Thursday.

items.name: Bo Melton
items.text: Melton logged 21 of 66 offensive snaps during Thursday's 35-14 loss to the Falcons but did not catch his only target. He also recorded two tackles and turned two kickoff returns into 46 yards.

items.name: Chris Brooks
items.text: Brooks caught his only target for four yards and added a tackle on special teams during the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons on Thursday.

items.name: Austin Hooper
items.text: Hooper caught both of his targets for 11 yards and a touchdown during Atlanta's 35-14 win over Green Bay on Thursday.

items.name: Zachariah Branch
items.text: Branch caught one pass on two targets for seven yards while logging an 18-yard punt return and a 22-yard kickoff return during the Falcons' 35-14 win over the Packers on Thursday.

items.name: Olamide Zaccheaus
items.text: Zaccheaus brought in both of his targets for nine yards and returned one punt for four yards during the Falcons' 35-14 win over the Packers on Thursday.

items.name: Kaleb Johnson
items.text: Johnson tallied four carries for six yards and gathered in one of three targets for 10 yards during Thursday's 35-14 loss to the Falcons.

items.name: Jahan Dotson
items.text: Dotson caught one pass on three targets for 11 yards during the Falcons' 35-14 win over the Packers on Thursday.

items.name: Alika Williams
items.text: Williams (upper body) isn't in the lineup for Saturday's game against the Astros.

items.name: Masyn Winn
items.text: Winn is absent from the lineup for Sunday's matchup against Washington.

items.name: Casey Mize
items.text: Mize (6-10) allowed seven runs on seven hits, two walks and a hit batsman while striking out one over four innings to take the loss versus the Diamondbacks on Friday.

items.name: Quinn Ewers
items.text: Ewers is set to be the backup quarterback for the Jaguars in Sunday's game against the Patriots, Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.

items.name: Jonah Coleman
items.text: Coleman (ankle) is being placed on injured reserve Saturday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

items.name: Nick Loftin
items.text: Loftin went 1-for-4 with a homer and two RBI during Tuesday's 14-11 loss to the White Sox.

items.name: Josh Jung
items.text: The Rangers placed Jung on the 10-day injured list Saturday with a fractured right hand.

items.name: Santi Aldama
items.text: Aldama (undisclosed) was limited during Saturday's practice, Noah Weber of TheSmokingCuban.com reported.

items.name: Jake Rogers
items.text: The White Sox placed Rogers on the paternity list Saturday.

items.name: Anthony Gould
items.text: The Colts signed Gould from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.

items.name: Jamaal Pritchett
items.text: The Jets signed Pritchett from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

items.name: Jeff Hoffman
items.text: Hoffman allowed a run on two walks and struck out one in a hitless inning to earn the save in Tuesday's 3-2 win over the Giants.

items.name: Kerry Carpenter
items.text: The Tigers announced Friday that Carpenter (foot) has ramped up his running and hitting progression with the hope of returning from the injured list before the end of the season, MLB.com reports.

items.name: Andrés Muñoz
items.text: The Mariners placed Munoz on the 15-day injured list Friday with right knee inflammation.

items.name: Jordan Whittington
items.text: Whittington (quadriceps) does not carry an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game versus Denver, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

items.name: Fernando Cruz
items.text: The Yankees transferred Cruz (elbow) to the 60-day injured list Friday.

items.name: Grant Williams
items.text: Williams will miss the preseason after suffering a right hamstring injury, the Hornets announced Friday.

items.name: Peyton Watson
items.text: Although head coach Kenny Atkinson said the starting lineup for the beginning of the 2026-27 season is not yet set, he praised Watson's (hamstring) fit in Cleveland and added that "there's a lot of room for growth in his offensive game," Chris Fedor of Cleveland.com reports.

items.name: Drew Lock
items.text: Lock will return to a backup role for Sunday's game at Washington after coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Sam Darnold (glute) is "going to play," John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

items.name: Daniel Bellinger
items.text: Bellinger (illness) does not have an injury designation heading into Sunday's game against the Giants.

items.name: Joc Pederson
items.text: Pederson (hand) took some swings in the batting cage Friday and is scheduled to face teammate Jack Leiter (ankle/biceps) in live batting practice this weekend, Shawn McFarland of The Dallas Morning News reports.

items.name: Kendre Miller
items.text: Miller (illness) doesn't carry an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Raiders.

items.name: Dylan Cease
items.text: Cease (shoulder) said Friday that he anticipates having a relatively normal offseason, Arden Zwelling of Sportsnet.ca reports.

items.name: DeeJay Dallas
items.text: Dallas (toe) practiced fully Friday and doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game in Tampa Bay.

items.name: Blaze Alexander
items.text: Orioles manager Craig Albernaz indicated Friday that Alexander (back) will not be activated from the 10-day injured list before the end of the season, Rich Dubroff of BaltimoreBaseball.com reports.

items.name: Burch Smith
items.text: Smith underwent arthroscopic surgery on his right shoulder Aug. 31, Chris McCosky of The Detroit News reports.

items.name: Parker Meadows
items.text: The Tigers announced Sept. 18 that Meadows (arm) has been taking part in a hitting progression at the team's spring training facility in Florida, MLB.com reports.

items.name: Kyrie Irving
items.text: Mavericks president Masai Ujiri offered an encouraging update on Irving's recovery Friday, saying the veteran guard is "right there" as he works toward returning to game action, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

items.name: Dereck Lively
items.text: Mavericks president Masai Ujiri said Friday that Lively (foot) is "making good progress" in his recovery, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

items.name: MarShawn Lloyd
items.text: Lloyd rushed four times for 11 yards and brought in two of three targets for seven yards in the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons on Thursday.

items.name: Kyle Pitts
items.text: Pitts secured one of two targets for five yards in the Falcons' 35-14 win over the Packers on Thursday.

items.name: Tucker Kraft
items.text: Kraft secured four of eight targets for 26 yards in the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons on Thursday. He also recovered a fumble.

items.name: Trey Smack
items.text: Smack went 0-for-1 on field-goal tries and 2-for-2 on extra-point attempts in Thursday's 35-14 loss to the Falcons.

items.name: Nick Folk
items.text: Folk hit both field-goal attempts and all three extra-point tries in Thursday's 35-14 win over the Packers.

items.name: Brian Robinson
items.text: Robinson rushed 10 times for 50 yards and a touchdown and returned two kickoffs for 54 yards in the Falcons' 35-14 win over the Packers on Thursday.

items.name: Michael Penix
items.text: Penix completed 18 of 25 passes for 256 yards with one touchdown and one interception while rushing twice for minus-2 yards in the Falcons' 35-14 win over the Packers on Thursday. He also threw a two-point conversion pass.

items.name: Drake London
items.text: London secured nine of 10 targets for 194 yards in the Falcons' 35-14 win over the Packers on Thursday.

items.name: Bijan Robinson
items.text: Robinson rushed 29 times for 194 yards and two touchdowns and brought in both targets for 19 yards in the Falcons' 35-14 win over the Packers on Thursday.

items.name: Dareke Young
items.text: Young (hamstring) was a full participant in practice Thursday.

items.name: Hurston Waldrep
items.text: Atlanta recalled Waldrep (elbow) from Triple-A Gwinnett on Thursday and placed him on the 60-day injured list.

items.name: Ben Joyce
items.text: The Angels placed Joyce on the 15-day injured list Thursday, retroactive to Sept. 21, due to right shoulder impingement.

items.name: Brock Rodden
items.text: The Mariners placed Rodden on the 10-day injured list Thursday with left patella tendon inflammation.

items.name: Luis Castillo
items.text: The White Sox placed Castillo on the 15-day injured list Thursday with a right shoulder impingement.

items.name: Thomas Sorber
items.text: Sorber will be limited to begin training camp, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

items.name: Nikola Topić
items.text: Topic (back) will be limited when training camp begins, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports

items.name: Alex Sarr
items.text: Sarr will be a partial participant when training camp begins as he continues his recovery from surgery to repair a fractured right foot,Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.

items.name: Jake Meyers
items.text: The Astros transferred Meyers (knee) to the 60-day injured list Wednesday, Brian McTaggart of MLB.com reports.

items.name: Miguel Andujar
items.text: Andujar (wrist) took live at-bats at Petco Park on Monday, MLB.com reports.

items.name: Ronnie Rivers
items.text: The Rams placed Rivers (calf) on their injured reserve list Wednesday.

items.name: Arian Smith
items.text: Smith (knee) underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn ACL and will miss the rest of the season, Antwan V. Staley of the New York Daily News reports.

items.name: Tony Santillan
items.text: Santillan will undergo surgery Thursday to repair a left hip labral tear, Gordon Wittenmyer of The Cincinnati Enquirer reports.

items.name: Spencer Steer
items.text: Steer will undergo right wrist surgery next Wednesday, Gordon Wittenmyer of the Cincinnati Enquirer reports.

items.name: Mitch Keller
items.text: Keller (shoulder) said Wednesday that he feels fully healthy and plans to resume throwing in late October, Aiden Stepansky of MLB.com reports.

items.name: Tyler O'Neill
items.text: O'Neill was given a PRP injection in his injured right shoulder recently, Matt Weyrich of The Baltimore Sun reports.

items.name: Samuel Basallo
items.text: The Orioles placed Basallo (concussion) on the 7-day injured list Wednesday.

items.name: Chase Burns
items.text: Burns (groin) worked on adding a sinker in his September outings before getting placed on the 15-day injured list to end his season, Charlie Goldsmith of FOX19 reports.

items.name: Jackson Holliday
items.text: Holliday will undergo left wrist surgery next week, Jake Rill of MLB.com reports.
